purpose: Subject galaxies of the atlas. Each roadmap belongs to the galaxy of its subject cluster (data/roadmap-classification.json). direction is the preferred bearing from Mathlib at the centre, in degrees clockwise from the right. The research areas sit beyond the nearer subjects they draw on most, judged by the roadmap prerequisite links between galaxies, and neighbouring bearings hold related subjects; distance from the centre comes from the classification. msc lists the Mathematics Subject Classification prefixes whose secondary classes tag a roadmap with this galaxy; the longest matching prefix wins.

galaxies.label: p-adic geometry
caption: p-adic
geometry
galaxies.description: Adic and perfectoid spaces, diamonds, prismatic and integral p-adic cohomology, p-adic Hodge theory and the Fargues–Fontaine curve.

galaxies.label: Foundations and homological algebra
caption: Foundations &
homological algebra
galaxies.description: The general machinery the rest of the atlas builds on: categories and homological algebra, derived and dg methods, and the logical and library foundations that several areas share.

galaxies.label: Étale and motivic cohomology
caption: Étale &
motivic cohomology
galaxies.description: Étale and ℓ-adic cohomology, weights and the Weil conjectures, vanishing cycles, and the comparison of cohomology theories.

galaxies.label: Algebraic geometry
caption: Algebraic
geometry
galaxies.description: Schemes and stacks, curves and their Jacobians, moduli, Hodge theory and stable reduction, over general bases.

galaxies.label: Function fields
caption: Function fields
galaxies.description: Arithmetic of global function fields and higher local fields: Drinfeld modules, shtukas and function-field Langlands.

galaxies.label: Algebra
caption: Algebra
galaxies.description: Commutative algebra and group theory: rings, modules and completions, finite and profinite groups, and the classification statements they support.

galaxies.label: Arithmetic geometry
caption: Arithmetic
geometry
galaxies.description: Elliptic curves and abelian varieties over arithmetic bases, heights and rational points, Néron models, and the finiteness theorems of Diophantine geometry.

galaxies.label: Analytic and computational number theory
caption: Analytic & computational
number theory
galaxies.description: Zeta and L-functions, sieves, exponential sums and the circle method, Diophantine approximation, and certified computation with arithmetic data.

galaxies.label: Galois representations and Langlands
caption: Galois representations
& Langlands
galaxies.description: Galois representations attached to automorphic forms, deformation theory and modularity lifting, and the p-adic and arithmetic Langlands correspondences.

galaxies.label: Modular and automorphic forms
caption: Modular &
automorphic forms
galaxies.description: Modular curves and modular forms, Shimura varieties, automorphic representations and their trace formulas.

galaxies.label: Algebraic number theory
caption: Algebraic
number theory
galaxies.description: Number fields and local fields, ramification, class field theory, Galois cohomology and quadratic forms over global and local fields.

galaxies.label: Iwasawa theory and special values
caption: Iwasawa theory &
special values
galaxies.description: p-adic L-functions, Euler systems and main conjectures, and the Birch–Swinnerton-Dyer and Bloch–Kato statements about special values.

galaxies.label: Probability and combinatorics
caption: Probability &
combinatorics
galaxies.description: Probability distributions and exchangeability, graph limits, additive combinatorics and coding theory.

galaxies.label: K-theory and motives
caption: K-theory
& motives
galaxies.description: Algebraic K-theory, regulators and polylogarithms, motives and periods, and the Habiro-ring constructions around them.

galaxies.label: Analysis and PDE
caption: Analysis
& PDE
galaxies.description: Complex analysis and contour integration, conformal mapping, semigroups, orthogonal bases, optimal transport and partial differential equations.

galaxies.label: Lie theory and representations
caption: Lie theory &
representations
galaxies.description: Lie groups and Lie algebras, reductive groups, root systems, and the representation theory of finite, compact and algebraic groups and of quivers.

galaxies.label: Geometric Langlands
caption: Geometric
Langlands
galaxies.description: The geometric and categorical Langlands programme: moduli of bundles and shtukas, Hecke stacks, geometric Satake and the spectral action.

galaxies.label: Topology and geometry
caption: Topology &
geometry
galaxies.description: Algebraic and geometric topology, low-dimensional manifolds and Floer homology, covering spaces and Riemannian geometry.
